_about: Ground tile types of the maps. walk: the hero can walk on the tile. art: the pictures of the tile (the game picks one for each tile). sprite: a tall picture that stands on each tile of this type (hedge-low: a low bamboo hedge on the sides of a map that face the camera, so that it does not cover the play area). slow: the speed factor on the tile. color: the top color of the tile (a palette name); the side faces of a raised tile use its shades.
